1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

This petition has been filed challenging the Public Notice dated 31st July 2025 issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 ('Act of 2013'), with respect to the land described in the prayer clause.

4. Counsel for petitioner seeks same direction that has been passed by this Court on 07th September 2025 in W.P.(C) 11820/2025 titled as "Lokesh Lochav & Anr. v. Govt. of NCT of Delhi & Ors."
5. Learned counsel for petitioner claims that, deviating from the scheme as prescribed under the Act of 2013, the Apex Court has fixed a schedule in This is a digitally signed order.

entities.text: Lokesh Lochav & Anr. v. Govt. of NCT of Delhi & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/09/2025 at 22:11:56 exercise of powers under Article 142 of the Constitution of India, 1950 ('Constitution'), and the schedule should have been adhered to by the respondents.

6. It is claimed that the Public Notice issued under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 is sans the schedule prescribed and, as such, attracts the consequences under Section 24(2) of the Act of 2013 for not completing the acquisition proceedings within schedule.

7. It is the contention of the counsel for petitioners that the schedule, since it is in deviation from the statutory provisions, i.e. Act of 2013 and is fixed in exercise of powers under Article 142 of the Constitution, has a mandatory effect and, as a sequel, the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 stands vitiated.
8. Accordingly, since the matter is similarly placed, issue notice.
9. Notices are accepted by Ms. Manika Tripathy, Standing Counsel for respondent no.4/ Delhi Development Authority (DDA) and Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak/Standing Counsel for respondent nos.1 & 2.

10. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September 2025.
11.

List on 22nd September 2025, to be listed along with W.P.(C) 11820/2025 titled as "Lokesh Lochav & Anr vs. Govt. NCT of Delhi & Ors."
12.
